source: uiuc_neuralfoil_validation.py: 55-airfoil clean benchmark, UIUC LSAT Vols 1-4, Re 60k-500k, NeuralFoil large, free transition
note: LD_band_pct is the median |dL/D|/L/D over the 3,151 clean benchmark points with CL > 0.2; the mean is 21%. The error is one-sided: NeuralFoil over-predicts L/D by 15% on average (20% at Re~100k). Drag error is ~9% when analysis_confidence > 0.95 and ~32% when it is < 0.5; lift error does not depend on confidence. Airfoils A and B operate at confidence 0.00 and 0.16, below the validated range, so their true error is at least this band.
systematic_bias: one-sided: true L/D <= predicted for most of the envelope
